hn.title: Backdoor in Claude Code for VS Code extension on the Cursor Marketplace
hn.content: TL;DR Phorion has detected a backdoor in the official Claude Code for VS Code extension bundle on the Cursor Marketplace that drops a persistent SSH backdoor across macOS, Linux, and Windows. This write-up focuses primarily on macOS, where the extension attempts to configure an SSH backdoor and establish persistence. Organisations should immediately review their environments for use of Claude Code for VSCode 2.1.312 or 2.1.313 and engage incident response where use of the extension is discovered. Revision history Initial publication 30 Oct, 05:30 UTC Marketplace correction 30 Oct, 09:13 UTC Corrected the affected marketplace to Cursor. Version-scope update 31 Oct, 00:43 UTC Added 2.1.312 per Cursor’s updated notice . Phorion has discovered a compromise of the official Claude Code for VS Code extension on the Cursor Marketplace, where the backdoored extension bundle contains a persistent Secure Shell (SSH) backdoor. Cursor has removed the affected versions, 2.1.312 and 2.1.313 , from its marketplace. While the implant includes setup and persistence logic for macOS, Linux, and Windows , we’re going to focus primarily on macOS in this post, calling out the key differences and a few implementation bugs on the other platforms along the way. The Cursor Marketplace serves extensions for the Cursor editor. Because extensions run with the permissions of the IDE and the user running it, a backdoored extension gets immediate access to local files, source code, and developer tooling as soon as its module is loaded. Notably, Phorion has discovered a likely oversight in how the malware tries to turn on SSH. The setup logic assumes it can check the current Remote Login state without root privileges. When run as a standard user, systemsetup -getremotelogin prints an administrator-access error and exits with status 0 instead of returning Off . Because the script only tries to enable SSH if the output matches Off , it skips the enablement step entirely. On a Mac that doesn’t already
hn.summary:
Phorion이 Cursor Marketplace에 배포된 공식 Claude Code for VS Code 확장 프로그램 번들에서 백도어를 발견한 글이다.
- 악성 코드는 macOS·Linux·Windows에서 지속적인 SSH 백도어를 설치하고 유지하는 로직을 포함하며, 글은 주로 macOS에서의 동작을 다룬다.
- 영향을 받는 버전은 2.1.312와 2.1.313이며, Cursor는 두 버전을 자사 마켓플레이스에서 삭제했다.
- 조직은 해당 버전의 사용 여부를 즉시 점검하고, 사용이 확인되면 사고 대응에 착수해야 한다고 권고한다.

hn.title: Northflank Breached
hn.content: Security incident Monitoring · Major outage Monitoring · November 02, 2026 at 11:09 AM UTC We believe the attack vector was contained within an hour of the first alert. Our investigation shows no sign that the attacker was in our environment after the attack. Independent forensic auditors began reviewing the attack together with Northflank over the weekend, and they continue to review it. Impact on your workloads Running workloads were unaffected. At this time we have seen no sign that workloads or workload data were accessed during the attack. Evidence suggests it was focused on secrets held in our control plane. Customers on forward-deployed or dedicated control planes are unaffected. Separately, we have patched CVE-2026-98432 across our fleet, including BYOC clusters where we have an active integration. If your BYOC cluster is no longer connected to Northflank, please contact support. Over the last few days there has been intermittent platform degradation while we rotated our own keys and hardened the platform. What you need to do Some customers have reported unauthorised use of AI secrets. Please rotate all secrets now, both integration secrets and project secrets, even if you haven’t seen suspicious activity. We recommend starting with AI provider keys, cloud provider credentials, payment provider keys, private keys, and database and other service credentials. We also recommend reviewing your provider logs for unusual activity. If you have seen unexpected AI usage or spend, contact your AI providers directly, such as OpenAI and Anthropic. Where we were able to act on your behalf, we have revoked Northflank access tokens and sessions, VCS integrations, and cross-account IAM roles and service accounts. If you haven’t already, sign in again and reconnect your integrations. Need help? If you need help rotating secrets or checking that everything has been rotated, contact support@northflank.com , or use your direct channel with us if you have one. We are treating th
hn.summary:
Northflank 보안 침해 사고의 조사 현황과 영향 범위, 고객 대응 조치를 알리는 공지다.
- Northflank는 첫 경보 후 1시간 이내에 공격 경로를 차단한 것으로 보고 있으며, 독립 포렌식 감사 기관과 조사를 진행 중이다.
- 실행 중인 워크로드는 영향을 받지 않았고, 워크로드나 그 데이터에 접근한 징후도 발견되지 않았다. 증거는 공격이 제어 영역에 저장된 비밀정보에 집중됐음을 시사하며, 전진 배치형 또는 전용 제어 영역을 사용하는 고객은 영향을 받지 않았다.
- 일부 고객이 AI 비밀정보의 무단 사용을 보고했다. 의심스러운 활동이 없어도 모든 통합·프로젝트 비밀정보를 즉시 교체하고, AI 제공업체 키·클라우드 자격증명·결제 키·개인 키·데이터베이스 등 서비스 자격증명부터 교체하며 제공업체 로그를 점검하도록 권고했다.

hn.title: Azure's Weakest Link – Five Full Cross-Tenant Compromises
hn.content: In my previous blog posts, Azure’s Weakest Link? and Azure’s Weakest Link - Full Cross-Tenant Compromise , I gave an overview of the severely insecure architecture behind API Connections in Azure, a part of Azure Logic Apps, and an instance of a full cross-tenant compromise using these inherent flaws. Now I am back with some more vulnerabilities in this system, each giving the same primitives to the attacker. In total, the vulnerabilities here netted me a cool $200,000. I also held a talk detailing this at Blue Hat Asia 2026, and when the recordings are out, I will add a link here. TL;DR API Connections allow anyone to fully compromise any other connection worldwide, giving full access to the connected backend. This includes cross-tenant compromise of Key Vaults and Azure SQL databases, as well as any other externally connected service, such as Jira or Salesforce. The only thing stopping exploitation is really the layers of input validation bolted onto the various systems, but as you will see, it is really difficult to catch all the edge cases here. Architecture If you haven’t read the first parts of this series, I would recommend checking those out first, Azure’s Weakest Link? - Part 1 and Azure’s Weakest Link - Full Cross-Tenant Compromise , but if you don’t care, I will go through the most important parts of the architecture first. From Microsoft’s documentation , we see a quite intriguing diagram of how the API Connection architecture is built. This basically spells out all that is needed to understand how the system operates, kudos to whoever made it! It works like this A logic app, the symbol on the bottom left, queries a shared Azure API Management instance The API Management instance first checks the swagger (OpenAPI) definition of the connector type and checks that it is a valid action A sort of key exchange happens where the input token, or key, is exchanged for the configured token for the backend service The API Management instance finishes the call with
hn.summary:
Azure Logic Apps의 API Connections 구조적 결함과 이를 이용한 테넌트 간 침해 취약점을 다룬 글이다.
- 공격자는 전 세계 다른 사용자의 API Connection을 완전히 장악하고, 연결된 Key Vault·Azure SQL 데이터베이스·Jira·Salesforce 등 백엔드에 전면 접근할 수 있다고 설명한다.
- 악용을 막는 방어는 여러 시스템에 덧붙인 입력 검증에 의존하며, 모든 예외적인 입력 사례를 걸러내기 어렵다고 지적한다.
- 저자는 이번 취약점들로 총 20만 달러의 보상금을 받았으며, Blue Hat Asia 2026에서 관련 내용을 발표했다.
